result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with a consistent layout. Found a couple of minor styling inconsistencies.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears slightly truncated at the right edge, showing as 'Tokumaru Ramei'.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the title container has enough width or apply proper ellipsis truncation so the full name or a clean truncation is displayed.
